PLAN "12-week Bone-Focused Strength for Perimenopausal Female"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Increase strength and bone-loading adaptations"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Heavy":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full - Moderate":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Heavy":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Heavy":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 7m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full - Moderate":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6 rpe 7.5 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7.5 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          sumo_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

        cooldown:

      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Volume":

          walking 7m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full - Light":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Deload":
        warmup:
          walking 8m

      DAY Friday training 40m "Active Recovery":

          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Progressive Overload (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):

    WEEK 7:
